results.description:
I Am Sober is more than just a free sobriety counter app.

Along with tracking your sober days, it helps you build new habits and provides ongoing motivation by connecting you to a wide network of people all striving for the same goal: staying sober one day at a time.

Through our growing sober community you can learn from others and contribute by sharing insights and tactics that have worked for you.

**The I Am Sober app features:**

• Sober day tracker
To visualize how long you’ve been sober.

• Remember why you quit
Add reasons and photos to help you remember why you want to quit your addiction and stay sober.

• Daily pledge tracker
Take a pledge every day. Sobriety is a 24-hour struggle, so start your day off by making a pledge to stay sober. Then you can review how your day went and log notes at the end of the day.

• Sobriety calculator
View how much money & time you’ve saved by being sober.

• Analyze triggers
Recap each day and find patterns that made your day easier or more challenging than the last.

• Share your story
Either with others or for yourself, take photos and journal your progress directly in the app. Then choose to share it or save it as a reminder for yourself.

• Milestone tracker
Track and celebrate your milestones from 1 day, to 1 week, to 1 month and beyond. Compare experiences with others on their sober journey. Read how they felt at this milestone and what you can expect. If you’re struggling, share your story and invite others to offer help or advice.

• Withdrawal timeline
When you create an account and declare your addiction, you can instantly see a withdrawal timeline to get an idea of what to expect for your next few days (and weeks). What’s more, you can contribute to it. See how many others saw an increase in their restfulness vs those that saw an increase in anxiety. Prepare yourself for what’s to come in recovery.

• Customize your experience
You set the time, your sober birthday, the category of motivation you need, the addictions you’re trying to break, even the end-of-day summaries. Make the app customized to your lifestyle and tailored to your needs.

**Sober Plus subscriptions**

I Am Sober is free to use, but you can support development of the app with a subscription to Sober Plus. With Sober Plus, you'll get access to these premium features:

• Create a group
Stay accountable together and track your sobriety privately. Groups are great for complimenting your real-world group like Alcoholics Anonymous, NA, SA, SMART Recovery, or your rehab center.

• Locked access
Keep your trackers private with a lock that you can access via TouchID or FaceID.

• Data Backups
Save your progress in the cloud and restore your trackers if you get a new device.

• More tracking
Track more addictions and get access to more communities. Even if your addiction is specific like Wine, Online Shopping, or Skin Picking, you’ll find a variety of communities of people who are all trying to get sober from alcohol, drugs, eating disorders, self-harm, and more.

results.description:
In a world obsessed with rigid schedules, hourly calendars, and stressful daily streaks, we often lose track of the dynamic, fluid rhythms of our actual lives. TimeSince is a premium, privacy-focused, local-first personal tracker designed to help you monitor the natural space between your moments.

Plants watered, parents called, car oil changed, migraine logged, TimeSince gives each one a gorgeous, secure home, and shows you the tempo you actually keep.

The Problem TimeSince Solves
Habit trackers and to-do lists assume life runs on rigid daily schedules. Anything without a fixed deadline slips through the cracks, leading to:

The "When Did I Last...?" Guesswork: Forgetting vital, irregular chores, medical routines, or social connections.
Rigid Tracker Anxiety: Stressing over broken "daily streaks" for habits that naturally recur every few days or weeks.
Scattered Information: Messy notebooks and spreadsheets holding your maintenance, health, and personal logs.
Privacy Concerns: Reluctance to log deeply personal or sensitive habits in cloud-hosted trackers.

TimeSince tracks the interval — time since last done — giving you a relaxing, data-rich way to manage life on your own terms.

Key Features & Deep Customization

1. Dynamic Event Customization
Make every tracked moment visually your own:

A rich spectrum of curated, premium color palettes.
Emoji icons to represent each event at a glance.
Custom image covers for full visual personalization.

2. Advanced Custom Logging (Beyond Timestamps)
Go beyond date-and-time stamps. Define custom inputs per event and attach structured fields to every log:

Numbers: Perfect for doses, volumes, or costs, complete with a built-in calculator keyboard.
Text Fields: For detailed, contextual journaling and notes.
Photos: Capture visual progress or evidence.

3. Privacy-First "Hidden Events"
Keep sensitive habits out of sight. A dedicated hidden layer, shielded by biometric security (Face ID / Touch ID), masks these events from the main UI and stores them in an encrypted database on your device.

4. Rhythm Analytics & Visual Statistics
Discover your natural habits. TimeSince analyzes your history to:

Calculate your average logging intervals.
Smartly categorize events by frequency ("Frequently" vs. "Infrequently" logged).
Render dynamic charts of interval trends and custom logged data over time.

5. Hands-Free Logging with Siri
Capture a moment the second it happens, without opening the app. Every counter gets ready-made Siri phrases:

"Hey Siri, Log Water the plants in TimeSince" to log and reset the interval.
"Hey Siri, How long since Water the plants in TimeSince" to hear where you stand.
Prefer shorter? Name your own shortcut and say just "Log Water" — or wire it to the Action Button or an automation.

6. Seamless Organization
Categorize with custom taxonomy, then sort by multi-select category pills, alphabetically, or by time — a growing library stays as calm as a small one.

7. Private iCloud Sync & Complete Data Ownership
Your history follows you between devices without ever passing through us:

iCloud Sync: Counters, logs, resets, profile, and settings back up automatically to your own private iCloud container — not our servers. Toggle it any time.
JSON Backups: Export your entire database to a portable file, and import it back on any device you own.
Erase on Your Terms: Wipe this device alone, or choose Erase Everywhere to clear the iCloud copy with it. No lingering copy.

Premium UI/UX & Native Engineering
Works Fully Offline: Every feature runs on-device. iCloud sync is optional and stays off until you enable it.

App of the Day 2026 (Apple) - Best ADHD App of 2025 (Forbes Health) - 5 million downloads

A habit tracker, routine tracker and day planner in one. Stack small habits into a daily routine, break it into 1-5 minute steps, and each step runs on its own timer while a voice calls out what comes next.

Morning routines, bedtime wind-downs, study blocks, workouts, medication - anything with a fixed order runs the same way.

WHY IT WORKS
- Starting gets easier. "Study" is too big to begin; "sit at the desk, 1 min" is not. Small steps lower the cost of the first move.
- Nothing to decide mid-run. You set the order once, when you built the routine. Nothing left to choose means less to stall on.
- Wins come back often. A finish is logged every step, not once a day.
- No time math. You set each step's length once. Sink into one thing and the voice pulls you out, so an afternoon doesn't vanish.

ASK CHATGPT OR CLAUDE TO BUILD IT
- "Make me a 40-minute weekday morning routine" and it lands in the app.
- Your assistant can handle routines alongside other tools you've connected there, like Google Calendar.
- Connects to ChatGPT, Claude and others over our MCP server, included in the free plan.

IT STARTS ON TIME, SCREEN OR NOT
- Set the weekdays and time; the reminder arrives then. Weekdays only, three times a week, whatever your schedule.
- The voice reads each step aloud, so the routine keeps running while you shower or cook.
- A home screen widget shows today's list without opening the app.
- Start on the phone, carry on from watch, tablet, or Mac.

STAY DEEP IN ONE THING
- A pomodoro that announces the next task, so the block keeps its own momentum.
- Build the environment: white noise, Focus mode, landscape view, Shortcuts.
- Stretch a timer, skip a step, reorder what's left - all without leaving the run.

DON'T DO IT ALONE
- Share a routine's task list with family or a friend and see how far each of you got.
- Finish a routine and the result goes straight to the person you picked.

SEE IT ADD UP
- A plant grows for each day you keep a streak; weekly and monthly stats show what holds.

FOR THE DAILY AND THE ONE-OFF
- Keep undated tasks and weekly repeats in one daily routine planner.
- A one-time task gets a timer too.
- Can't face it now? Park it in Anytime for later.
- Shift work that moves weekly still fits: Morning, Afternoon, Evening.
- See the day as a list, a calendar, or a timeline.

WHO USES ROUTINERY
- Adults with ADHD who know the task and still can't start
- People who lose hours once they sink into something
- People who double-check in case they missed one
- Anyone who waits to start until they can do it perfectly
- Shift workers, people on daily medication, parents on the school run
- Anyone who wrote a routine down and never once ran it

ROUTINERY AT A GLANCE

Is Routinery free?
Yes. 2 routines free, no account, first one running in under a minute. Premium lifts the routine cap: monthly, 6-month or yearly. The free plan shows ads; Premium is ad-free.

Do I need an account, and what about privacy?
No account, no sign-up. Routine data is stored on our servers; usage analytics go through third-party tools. What you type is never used to train AI models. Email hello@routinery.app and we delete your data.

Does Routinery work offline?
Almost entirely. Routines, timers, voice, reminders and history run offline. Only device sync needs a connection.

What does Routinery connect to?
Siri Shortcuts, widgets, Apple Watch, and AI assistants over MCP. No direct sync with Apple Health or calendars. No export button either; pull your data out over MCP instead, free plan included.

What devices does Routinery run on?
iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. No web version.

Questions, bugs or ideas: hello@routinery.app

Routinery is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat ADHD.

results.description:
Build a good habit. Break a bad one. Mark the day. Keep the count.

A goal sits ahead of you and reminds you daily that you're not there yet. What's done works the other way round: it's already yours, and nobody can take it back. "Read" and "didn't smoke" look the same to the counter: one more day for yourself, not for autopilot.

TWO ACTIONS, NOT TEN
In the morning, tap today — your intention. In the evening, tap again — done; once more — an honest “didn't work out”. Prefer plain marking? Turn off Intention mode in Settings. A past day cycles with each tap: done, almost, didn't work out, empty. Long-press a day for a note and the other actions. Tap the top row of the card for your path so far.

SEE HOW FAR YOU'VE COME
Every day of a streak is a notch, starting with the first. Seven notches get struck through with one line, the way people counted what they'd lived through long before apps. The habit's card shows your path in notches, bundled by seven; "almost" stands apart and isn't counted. Details show five weeks and your record. Free shows 30 days of your path; Pro shows all of it. The past lies to the left of "Today": swipe there and you'll see "Last 30 days" of every habit together.

THE FLAME GROWS WITH YOUR STREAK
For the first six days an ember glows next to the number. From day seven a flame breaks out of it, growing and changing shape at 14, 21, 30, 45, 60 and 100 days. For daily habits, how much is left until the next level shows on the card.

The number on the card keeps growing, and the bigger it gets, the less you want to hand it over. That's the whole mechanic.

REPORT: THE ANSWER AT A GLANCE
One number, the percentage of days marked this month, and next to it, what last month was. Below it: 12 weeks as bars with a goal line, each habit's records with dates, and a calendar showing your best days. At the start of a month, a short story: what worked, where you came back, which streak is longest, and a poster for stories without habit names.

NOTCHES THAT DON'T DISAPPEAR
Your first mark, seven days, coming back the day after a miss, your first "almost": each of these steps leaves a notch in your profile. No miss takes them away. Once a month, when a daily habit has 21 marks, you can spend 20 seconds rating how automatic it already is, on a scientific scale of four statements.

NOT EVERYTHING IS DAILY
The gym three times a week is a completed week, not four failed days. No drinking on weekdays is a completed week. Calling your parents twice a month is a completed month. Sweets no more than twice a week is a completed week too. The number is measured in the unit you actually live in.

ONE SLIP DOESN'T WIPE IT ALL
Many trackers erase the number after a single miss — which is why it rarely grows big enough to be worth protecting. In a daily habit, three days in a row earn you one free miss. Two misses in a row do break it, and forgiveness doesn't stack. And when it's really not the time — injury, moving house — put the habit on Pause: the counter waits with you.

If you'd rather have no safety net, the forgiveness rule switches off in Settings.

ON YOUR WRIST AND ON YOUR HOME SCREEN

HOW DOES IT WORK?

We’ve all seen new years resolutions fail. You start the year with a ton of inspiration, but by week three you’re struggling to stay on track. You can’t rely on inspiration alone! Streakster makes it simple. We’ll give you a daily plan, remind you, and track what you accomplish. With Streakster’s routine planning you can turn that inspiration into real life changes that last.

CAN YOU REALLY IMPROVE YOUR LIFE BY USING STREAKSTER?

Absolutely. Experts agree that building a healthy daily routine is the best way to feel accomplished and motivated. Studies show a consistent routine has many more physical and mental health benefits than other self care strategies out there today. Streakster uses tested behavioral science to remind and motivate you, helping you succeed during your self-improvement journey.

IS STREAKSTER THE APP I’VE BEEN LOOKING FOR?

Yes. Our self-improvement app is great for people who love a routine and for those new to a regular routine. All you need is your motivation to change your lifestyle and your commitment to follow a routine.

HOW TO SUCCEED WITH STREAKSTER

According to self-care researchers, people who set a smaller number of 1 or 2 habit goals to start with, and consistently reach them, were significantly more successful than those who try to drastically change their routine all at once. The key is getting small, reachable wins that build confidence. As you build up a streak, then add in another habit. CONSISTENT ROUTINE = CONSISTENT STABILITY

Most fitness apps count what you did. Trajecta tells you whether it moved you toward your goal.

Start with the free assessment: 14 questions, your first Trajecta Score from 0 to 100, and a real diagnosis across training, nutrition and momentum, before you pay anything.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Pick your goal. Lose fat, build muscle, or both - body recomposition.

2. Get your Trajecta Score. Trajecta works out what your goal actually demands, measures it against what you are doing now, and scores how close the two are, 0 to 100.

3. Log your day. Every meal and every session is scored against your goal, not a generic target. Calories, protein, lifting and cardio all pay points into one Daily Score.

4. Watch your score climb. Every morning your Trajecta Score moves toward the day you just had, so you can see whether you are actually running your plan, day after day.

When what you do and what your goal demands line up, you are on trajectory. The job after that is staying there.

WHAT YOU GET

Trajecta Score - one number, 0 to 100, for how well your habits match your goal. It moves every morning with how you ate and trained.

Daily Score - what you ate and what you trained both pay into a single score for today, weighted by the goal you picked. Lose Fat scores cardio differently from Build Muscle, because the goals are different.

A plan built from your answers - calorie and protein ranges, lift and cardio frequency, all worked out from your goal, your bodyweight and the training time you actually have.

Food logging that is not a chore - barcode scanning, a searchable food database, saved meals, and an estimate for anything you cannot find. Your day reads as one line per meal, with what is left to eat on top.

Session logging that counts - lifts, cardio, sport, yoga and more, scored by what you didnot just that you showed up.

Weight goals with a real timeline - set a target and a date and Trajecta works out the rathat rate stops being safe.

Group challenges - ranked on percent of your own goal and scaled by how hard that goal isg an easy one.

Streaks and shields - a run survives one missed day if you earn it back.

Trajecta Coach - a daily read on what your own numbers are saying, written from your logs

WHO IT IS FOR

People already putting in the work who are not seeing it show up. If you train, you eat rill cannot tell whether this week counted - that is the question Trajecta exists toanswer.

Whether you are cutting, bulking or recomping, Trajecta measures the same thing: how closely what you are doing matches what your goal needs.

FREE TO START

The assessment, your first Trajecta Score and your diagnosis are free. Trajecta Pro unlocks your daily plan, food and training logging, your Trajecta Score every morning, and group challenges.

results.description:
You've done this before. You started strong, you missed a Tuesday, and the app made sure you knew it. The number went back to zero, and you stopped opening it a few days later. That's not a discipline problem. That's an app that only knew how to keep score.

HabitScript keeps the whole picture instead. The water you drank. The ten minutes on the mat. The twenty pages before bed, the phone left in the kitchen. Miss a Tuesday and Tuesday is just a day — everything else you did is still there, still yours, still visible.

AS MANY HABITS AS YOUR LIFE HAS

Other apps let you have three, maybe five, then ask for money. HabitScript doesn't count your habits. Add the one you're serious about and the small one you're embarrassed about. Add the one you'll drop in a week. Free means free.

NOTHING TO PROTECT, NOTHING TO LOSE

There's no fragile number you owe the app. Nothing scolds you, nothing resets to zero, and nobody's disappointed in you on Thursday morning. Come back after a bad week and you'll find the good weeks still sitting there.

IT'S YOURS, AND IT STAYS YOURS

No account. No sign-up, no email, no password to forget. Your habits live encrypted on your phone.

HOW IT ACTUALLY WORKS

• Some things you just do — tap once and it's done
• Some you count — a glass of water at a time, until you've had eight
• Some you sit down for — ten minutes of stretching, timed in the app
• Pick the days that are real for you: every day, weekdays, or three times a week
• Want a plan instead of a blank page? Answer a few questions and HabitScript builds you a routine — mornings, fitness, focus, reading, less phone

Give it a few weeks and something quiet happens: the months behind you fill in with color, and you can see, without counting, that you've been doing this.

PERFECT FOR

• Anyone who has deleted three habit apps already
• People who want the proof without the pressure
• Anyone starting over — again — and hoping it holds this time

SUBSCRIPTION & PURCHASE OPTIONS

Auto-renewal: subscriptions automatically renew unless disabled 24 hours before the period ends. Manage subscription in Account Settings.
Trial Information: The trial converts to a subscription unless canceled 24 hours before the trial ends.

Start a timer when you sit down knit, crochet, or stitch. Pause mid-row, pick up later, or log time after the fact. Cabled reminds you if a session is still running so nothing disappears.

YOUR PATTERN, RIGHT IN YOUR SESSION
Open your PDF pattern while you work. Mark your charts with movable guides, zoom in on details, and keep your Row Counters floating on top. No AI parsing, no copyright violations - just simpler tracking, all in one place.

ROW COUNTERS THAT KEEP UP

TIME BY SECTION

Knitting, crochet, Tunisian crochet, embroidery, cross stitch, sewing, quilting, English paper piecing, sashiko, spinning and weaving. Choose your craft at the start of a project and the app uses the right language.

PROJECTS FROM CAST ON TO FO
Keep works in progress in one place. Move a project through its life: active, hibernating, finished object, or frogged. Add photos, notes and row counters so the next session starts where you left off.

RAVELRY BUILT IN
Search Ravelry's pattern library when you start a Project and the details will fill themselves in. When you finish, send your Project, photos and Notes to Ravelry in one tap.

TRACK YOUR STASH
Keep all your supplies in one place, with quantities, colourways and photos. Import your Stash from Ravelry, link materials to Projects as you use them, and adjust remaining quantities when you finish a Project.

Create the habits you want to build — exercise, reading, meditation, journaling, drinking water, skincare, or anything else. Each habit gets its own tile-based grid chart that visualizes your consistency over time. Tap to mark a day complete and watch your grid fill in. Your habit streak grows every day you show up, and the longer your streak, the harder it becomes to break it. That is the psychology that makes Rituals work.

What makes Rituals different from other habit trackers:
Most habit tracking apps overwhelm you with features — point systems, challenges, social feeds, complicated goal hierarchies. Rituals strips all of that away. You get a grid, your habit streaks, and your data. That is it. The design is intentionally warm and inviting instead of dark and clinical. Light backgrounds with soft orange and pink accents make opening the app feel calm rather than stressful. Choose from warm, carefully designed themes that make your daily check-in feel inviting instead of sterile. Most habit trackers look like developer tools. Rituals looks like something you actually want to open every morning. This matters because you open your habit tracker every single day, and how it feels determines whether you keep using it.

Rituals is the best habit tracker for people who want something simpler than Streaks, more visual than Done, and warmer than HabitKit. It is designed for people who care about consistency, not gamification.

Who Rituals is for:
People building a morning or evening routine who need a streak tracker that stays out of the way. Anyone who has tried Habitify, Streaks, or HabitKit and found them too complex or too cold. People tracking health habits like water intake, sleep, stretching, supplements, or meal prep. Anyone using a habit journal on paper who wants to go digital without losing the simplicity. People with ADHD or executive function challenges who benefit from visual progress and reduced choices. Fitness consistency — gym visits, running, yoga, walking, strength training. Personal growth habits — reading, language learning, gratitude, daily writing.

How habit streaks keep you consistent:
The habit streak is the core of Rituals. Every day you complete a habit, your streak grows. The grid fills in, the number climbs, and your brain gets a small reward for showing up. Over weeks and months, your streak becomes something you protect. You stop asking whether you feel like doing the habit — you just do it because you do not want to break the chain. Rituals makes your streaks visible, satisfying, and impossible to ignore.

results.description:
Create good habits. Break bad ones. Build a better you. Habit List includes everything you need to reach your goals, wrapped in a beautiful and intuitive interface. It motivates you, helps you stay focused, and keeps you on track.

Get motivated with streaks — Keeping streaks alive is a powerful motivator. See how high you can go, then try to beat your personal best. Red badges mean you've slacked and need to get back on track. Yellow badges show up after a streak ends, indicating it's time to recommit to building a new one. Gray badges are optional, missing them won’t break your streak. Green means go, complete it today!

Focus on what’s due — No need to wade through all your habits to figure out what to do, Habit List only shows what’s due today. And you can set the default order for your habits, so items that you’ll complete first are at the top of your list. Habit List's beautiful, distraction-free design keeps you focused and on task.

Stay on track with reminders and badges — Habits are powerful because they’re automatic, but while you’re building routines, reminders are indispensable. App badges show the number of remaining habits for the day, great for reminding you to complete your list. You can even set a daily review reminder to get in the habit of using the app.

View trends over time — Step back and see the big picture with weekly and monthly completion percentages. Bar colors range from green to red and give a visual indicator of how you’re doing.

Flexible scheduling — Choose from 3 kinds of schedules: Specific Days, Non-specific Days, or Intervals. So you can schedule your workouts M-W-F, bring lunch to work any 4 days per week, or write a blog post every 2-3 days. No matter what kind of habit you're building, Habit List has you covered.

Track your progress — See your history at a glance and gain insight into what's working—or isn't. Always miss your Friday workout? Maybe a different day or early morning routine would work better. Habit List also tracks your personal best (longest streak) and total completions.

No detail too small — Need to track multiple times per day habits, like drinking 8 glasses of water? No problem. Going on vacation? Skip habits without breaking your streak. Miss a habit early in the day? Mark it as missed to keep your list uncluttered. You can also change the week start date, use light or dark mode, and keep things private with a passcode or touch ID. Speaking of privacy, we don’t require you to set up an account, don’t track your habits, and your personal data is 100% private.

Try Habit List for free — Your first three habits are on us. Upgrade to Premium for unlimited habits, passcode/touch ID lock, dark mode, and support future development.
